name: Skittering Sands / actual Ashwing is not Ash and failed Red does not earn Dragon go again
printed_text:
**Transform** target ash you control into an Aether Ashwing. It gets +3{p} until end of turn.

**Go again**
format_scope: Four genuine manual legal young natural20 Heroes. Dromai20 controls a real prior Ashwing7 with canonical native UPR_ASH1/DYN_ASHash material representation, and actualStorm8 grants Dragon attack ability. This Ally is not an Ash permanent target despite its Ash material history. RealBlueSigil6 resolves after allfour responses→HP21/AP1. PrimaryRed5cost0 click must refuse noAsh, preserving physicalcards/AP/playhistory. ActualStorm-granted Dragon7 then attacks adjacentHero4 for printed1, noGA because onlyBlueSigil was played and refusedRed was not. Fullmanualcombat deals1HP19, AP0, sameAlly7used/Ashmaterialcountersintact/Storm8ready, proxy9removed rather thanownedGY.
